newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Entel to invest $320 mln in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Entel to invest $320 mln in 1997.

text.p: Chilean telecom Entel Chile SA said it will invest $320 million this year in projects including expanding its local telephone service and completing its long-distance fiber-optic network.
The company plans to spend $120 million this year spreading its fledgling local telephone service throughout Santiago, CEO Richard Buchi told a news conference.
"This cable network will include products from local telephone services to cable television," said Buchi.

The program will be financed by using funds from the $273 million capital increase last year which was paid for by Italian telecom Stet SpA. Stet owns around 16 percent of Entel, Chile's largest long-distance carrier.
Other projects include investing $80 million in expanding the company's recently set-up personal telephone network throughout the country, said Buchi.
